passages.note: House Third Reading vote detail shows Nguyen voted Y on SB1165, a single-subject bill on interscholastic/intramural athletics and biological sex.
passages.actor_quote: MEZA N NGUYEN Y OSBORNE Y

passages.note: Bill status page lists Nguyen as a co-sponsor of SB1165 and records its House/Senate passage and the Governor's signature.

passages.provision_quote: Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex.
passages.note: Enacted text designates teams by biological sex and bars males from girls'/women's teams while leaving boys' and coed teams unrestricted.

rows.reasoning: Nguyen co-sponsored and voted Yea on SB 1165 (2022), a single-subject bill whose operative text provides that teams designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex while leaving boys' and coed teams unrestricted, matching "require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth" and excluding the complete ban of rung 5.
